marketingFooter.tagline: The time-tracking admin platform for teams that care about output — and the people behind it.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to manage your workspace, team, and projects.

signUp.title: Start tracking in minutes
signUp.subtitle: Spin up your admin account — no card required for the first 14 days.

verifyEmail.title: Enter the 6-digit code
verifyEmail.subtitleSuffix: . Enter it below to confirm your address and finish creating your workspace.
verifyEmail.codeHint: Check your email for the code we just sent.
verifyEmail.missingEmail: Missing email — please sign up again.
verifyEmail.invalidCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your email.

request.title: Reset your password
request.subtitle: Enter the email linked to your account — we'll send you a 6-digit code.

confirm.title: Enter the 6-digit code
confirm.subtitleSuffix: . Enter it below with your new password. The code is valid for 30 minutes.
confirm.codeHint: Check your email for the code we just sent.
confirm.invalidCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your email.
confirm.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters long.

done.title: Password updated
done.subtitle: Your password has been updated. Open the WorkTracker desktop app and sign in with your new password.
done.panelMessage: Open the WorkTracker desktop app and sign in with your email and the new password.

dashboard.subtitle: Your activity and screenshots captured by the desktop app.

table.empty: No activity recorded for this range yet.

dashboard.desktopHint: Download WorkTracker desktop to start tracking automatically.

activity.title: Activity logs
activity.subtitle: Review keyboard and mouse activity captured by the desktop app.

table.timezoneNote: Times shown in your local timezone ({{tz}})

activity.empty: No activity found for the selected filters.

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.subtitle: Browse screenshots uploaded by the desktop app for your team.
screenshots.empty: No screenshots found for the selected filters.

team.title: Invite teammates
team.subtitle: Create accounts for people on your team. Share the temporary password with them — they can change it later from the reset password page.
team.tempPasswordHint: You'll share this with the teammate. They can reset it anytime.
team.recentlyInvitedEmpty: People you invite during this session will appear here.
team.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters long.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.subtitle: These settings apply to every teammate tracked by the desktop app.
settings.intervalHint: How often desktop clients roll up keyboard & mouse counts into an activity log entry.
settings.intervalInvalid: Interval must be a positive number of minutes.

download.subtitle: Let's get you set up. Install the WorkTracker desktop app on every computer that should track time — it runs quietly in the background and syncs with your admin panel in real time.

installation.title: Installation steps
installation.step1Text: Pick the file for your operating system above.
installation.step2Text: The installer will walk you through setup in under a minute.
installation.step3Text: Open the app and sign in as {{email}}.
installation.step4Text: The app syncs silently with your admin panel whenever you're online.

rollout.title: Rolling out to your team?
rollout.text: Share the install link with teammates. They'll sign in with their own credentials and land in the right workspace automatically.

help.title: Need help?
help.text: Read the setup guide or chat with support — most installations are live in under 3 minutes.

hero.titleStart: Time tracking that your team will
hero.subtitle: WorkTracker gives admins a single place to manage people, projects, and payouts — while your team stays focused on the work that moves the business.
